text:
I need to determine which New York borough contains Hell's Kitchen.

Hell's Kitchen is a well-known neighborhood in New York City. It is located on the West Side of Midtown Manhattan, roughly between 34th Street and 59th Street, west of Eighth Avenue to the Hudson River.

Both other agents answered Manhattan with very high confidence (0.98 and 1.00), and this aligns with my knowledge. Hell's Kitchen is definitively in Manhattan - this is a well-established geographical fact about New York City neighborhoods.

Answer: Manhattan
Confidence: 1.00
